scenarios.name: pair_root_direct
scenarios.description: An offer sealed by a root with no approval pins that root; it receives directly.

scenarios.name: pair_working_key
scenarios.description: An offer sealed by W carrying R's approval pins R, not W, and binds W.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_approval_names_other_key
scenarios.description: The approval's p must be the seal author.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_invalid_approval
scenarios.description: An offer sealed by W without a valid approval for W is refused.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_not_an_approval
scenarios.description: The carried statement must be an approval.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_wrong_token
scenarios.description: Token rules are as for scan-to-pair.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_token_expired
scenarios.description: 600-second token lifetime from the mint time.

scenarios.name: pair_refused_future_ts
scenarios.description: A future-dated offer ts is refused.

scenarios.name: seal_exception_1
scenarios.description: An approval may be sealed only by the W it names.

scenarios.name: seal_exception_2
scenarios.description: A withdrawal, co-guardian, removal, move or cancel signed by R may be sealed by a current W bound to R; not by another root's W, a non-signer or a departed W.

scenarios.name: approval_for_unpinned_root
scenarios.description: An approval for a root that isn't pinned is dropped; its W's events are dropped, not buffered.

scenarios.name: rule1_binding
scenarios.description: W binds to the root of the first valid approval; approvals for W from another root are ignored.

scenarios.name: rule2_ordering
scenarios.description: No pairing floor for statements; newest issuedAt per d wins; duplicate, stale and same-second different content are dropped.

scenarios.name: rule3_withdrawal
scenarios.description: Withdrawal counts only from the binding root and is permanent.

scenarios.name: rule3_early_withdrawal
scenarios.description: A withdrawal before W is bound is held if a pinned root signed it, and pre-empts that root's approval; an unpinned signer's is dropped.

scenarios.name: rule2_tie_withdrawal_wins
scenarios.description: A withdrawal and an approval at the same issuedAt: the withdrawal wins in either order.

scenarios.name: rule4_departure_clauses
scenarios.description: Departed keys sign nothing new; their clauses stay until a current signer replaces them; their issuedAt is ignored, a current signer's is not.

scenarios.name: future_refusal
scenarios.description: A CLAUSE or statement more than 300 seconds ahead of the ward clock is refused; exactly 300 is accepted.

scenarios.name: signer_gate_grant_usage_sync
scenarios.description: GRANT and USAGE_SYNC authors must be in the signer set, seal = author, and not more than 300 s ahead.

scenarios.name: rule6_coguardian
scenarios.description: A co-guardian takes effect only after presence confirmation by an install bound to R2, which carries R2's approval; then both roots have equal authority.

scenarios.name: presence_token_lifetime
scenarios.description: A presence token lives 600 seconds and is single use.

scenarios.name: root_quota
scenarios.description: At most 4 roots: a fifth co-guardian is refused.

scenarios.name: key_quota
scenarios.description: At most 16 active working keys per root; a withdrawal frees a slot.

scenarios.name: held_quota
scenarios.description: 64 held early statements per root; past it they are dropped, and a root at quota can't approve new working keys.

scenarios.name: rule7_self_removal
scenarios.description: Signed by R2 itself, a removal takes effect at once, unless R2 is the last root.

scenarios.name: rule7_removal_by_other_root
scenarios.description: Signed by another root: presence by an R1-bound install, then the later of confirmation and max(issuedAt, receipt) + 72 h; R2 and its keys depart and get one last STATUS.

scenarios.name: rule7_removal_confirmed_after_notice
scenarios.description: Confirmed after the 72 hours, a removal applies at once.

scenarios.name: rule7_objection
scenarios.description: The root being removed objects; that drops the removal. An objection is not covered by seal exception 2.

scenarios.name: rule7_objection_first
scenarios.description: An objection that arrives before its removal is held and drops it on arrival; for 7 days after the objection any removal by that remover is refused.

scenarios.name: rule7_pending_dropped_on_removal
scenarios.description: Once a removal applies, every pending statement signed by R2 is dropped.

scenarios.name: rule7_repin
scenarios.description: Re-pinning a removed root needs a co-guardian newer than the removal; a same-second one loses. Its old working keys stay departed.

scenarios.name: rule7_never_no_roots
scenarios.description: A removal that would leave no root is refused, when it would take effect too.

scenarios.name: rule8_move
scenarios.description: A move takes effect after presence by an R2-bound install; R stays pinned until then. The confirming W travels; R's other keys depart and only R2 may re-bind them.

scenarios.name: rule8_move_cancelled
scenarios.description: R can cancel its pending move; a move signed by a working key is not a root statement.

scenarios.name: pending_expiry
scenarios.description: expiresAt is clamped to 7 days after issuedAt (7 days without one); a pending statement expires at it; one already expired is dropped.

scenarios.name: removal_expires_before_effect
scenarios.description: A removal whose expiresAt comes before issuedAt + 72 h expires instead of taking effect.

scenarios.name: cancel_lifecycle
scenarios.description: A cancel drops pending with its d at or below its issuedAt (a same-second tie included); a later statement is unaffected; only the signer may cancel; a cancel that arrives first is held and binds only its own signer.

scenarios.name: rule9_recipients
scenarios.description: A root with no W in the set receives directly; once it has one, its working keys do. A withdrawn key gets one last STATUS.

scenarios.name: rule11_relays
scenarios.description: A RELAYS change from any signer applies; a multi-root ward also sends STATUS on every list replaced within the last 7 days.

scenarios.name: relays_existing_checks
scenarios.description: The existing RELAYS checks apply first: no future created_at, at most 600 s old, not before pairing, newer than the last applied.

scenarios.name: relays_guardian_pin
scenarios.description: guardianPin is accepted only from a gift-wrapped RELAYS; a pasted relay code carrying one is refused whole.

scenarios.name: coguardian_and_move_same_root
scenarios.description: A co-guardian and a move naming the same R2: once one pins R2 the other is dropped, so R2 is never pinned twice and a later self-removal can't empty the ward.

scenarios.name: confirm_rechecks_root_role
scenarios.description: A confirmation re-checks R2: if R2 has become a working key meanwhile, the co-guardian can't pin it.

scenarios.name: removal_notice_from_receipt
scenarios.description: The 72-hour notice runs from the later of issuedAt and the ward's receipt, so a backdated removal still waits 72 hours.

scenarios.name: objection_below_pending_removal
scenarios.description: An objection drops the pending removal by its p whatever the two issuedAt (here the objection's is older).

scenarios.name: removal_reissued_after_objection
scenarios.description: After an objection, the same remover's new removals of the objector are refused for 7 days from the objection's receipt.

scenarios.name: clause_replay_after_departure
scenarios.description: A relay can't restore an older rule from a current signer: the departed signer's clause keeps a floor of min(issuedAt, departure time).

scenarios.name: departed_root_as_working_key
scenarios.description: A removed root can't come back as another root's working key.

scenarios.name: withdrawal_of_move_departed_key
scenarios.description: A key that departed with a move can be withdrawn for good by the new root, or by its old root once that is pinned again.

scenarios.name: timer_tie_mutual_removals
scenarios.description: Two confirmed removals due the same second (R1 removes R2, R2 removes R1): the lower d applies first, and the other, signed by the removed root, is dropped with it.

scenarios.name: token_dropped_with_its_statement
scenarios.description: A token bound to a d goes when that pending statement is cancelled; a new pending statement with the same d needs a new token.

scenarios.name: removal_sealed_by_removed_roots_key
scenarios.description: R1's removal of R2 sealed by R2's working key is refused: exception 2 needs a W bound to the signer.

scenarios.name: cancel_per_signer
scenarios.description: Cancels are kept per signer: another root's held cancel for the same d does not shadow the signer's own cancel.

scenarios.name: same_second_tie_lowest_id
scenarios.description: Two statements with the same d and issuedAt: the lower event id wins whichever arrives first.

scenarios.name: confirm_clears_held_withdrawals
scenarios.description: Binding W at a confirmation discards other roots' held withdrawals for W, as an ordinary approval does.

scenarios.name: giftwrap_setup
scenarios.description: Setup for giftwrap.json: paired by W1 (R1), with W1b approved.
